title: A request could point the AI at any server, and the stored API key went with it
actor: Anyone using the browser on the workshop laptop (devtools or curl); no password
path: body.overrides.llm_base_url -> _apply_overrides (accepted: listed in ADJUSTABLE) -> _model_settings -> build_call_fn(base_url) -> _openai_style/_anthropic/_google send the stored key (Authorization / x-api-key / ?key=) to that URL
result: The settings lock is bypassed: the AI service, model and address change without the password, and the provider API key from .env is sent to a server of the actor's choosing.
evidence: Local request POST /api/run with overrides {llm_provider: openai, llm_base_url: http://127.0.0.1:9/steal} returned 200 before the fix; /api/models/test accepted a base_url without the password.
fix: Any override of a settings-menu field (SITE_FIELDS: llm_*, grid contract, installation, prices) and /api/models/test now require the admin token (server.py do_POST).
siblings: Checked every POST that reads body.overrides; all pass through the same gate. GET /api/consent only accepts participant_id and condition.

title: Other participants' reasons, chat and research data were readable without the password
actor: A workshop participant at the shared laptop, typing a URL
path: GET request -> do_GET -> list_preferences / fair_bundle / list_deliberations ... with no authorisation check
result: Free-text disagreement reasons and chat of every participant (e.g. 'sick colleague Jan'), the full research bundle and all past plans were readable. Pseudonymised, but personal data under GDPR Art. 4(5).
evidence: Local request GET /api/preferences returned another participant's reason verbatim; /api/export/fair returned the JSON-LD bundle (200).
fix: These GET routes require the admin token (_ADMIN_GETS). The setup page downloads exports with the token instead of plain links; the older pages ask for the password when needed.

title: Anyone could withdraw or change another participant's consent, erasing their data
actor: A participant who guesses another pseudonym (P001, P002 ...)
path: body.participant_id -> withdraw_consent -> consent.erase(stores) with no proof of identity; grant_consent overwrote an existing consent the same way
result: Another participant's research data is erased, or their consent scopes changed.
evidence: Code path traced: withdraw_consent erased stores for any participant_id in the body; no identity check before the fix. The regression test now proves refusal without the key.
fix: Consenting returns a withdrawal key once (only its SHA-256 hash is stored, admin_auth.ConsentKeys). Withdrawing or changing an existing consent needs that key or the admin token. The participant's browser keeps the key.
siblings: setup.js (researcher) uses the admin token; grower.js and demo.js store and send the key.

title: Form controls in the goals form had no accessible name
path: select#goal-metric, select#goal-op, input#goal-value without label or aria-label
result: WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 and 1.3.1 failed: the controls are announced without a purpose.
evidence: axe-core 4.10 (wcag2a/aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa): label (critical) and select-name (critical) on the prepare screen.

title: Smaller accessibility gaps: landmarks, nested interactive, pressed state, hover-only meaning, motion
path: Simulation notice and toast outside landmarks; role=img container holding a details element; response buttons without aria-pressed; fact chips and hour strips explained only in a title tooltip; smooth scrolling ignoring prefers-reduced-motion; admin login outside a main landmark
result: WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2 and 2.3.3 (AAA, best practice) issues; status messages not announced (4.1.3).
evidence: axe-core: region, nested-interactive, landmark-one-main; manual review for aria-pressed, tooltips and motion.
fix: Region and live-region roles, aria-pressed, visually hidden labels and role=img with aria-label, a prefers-reduced-motion switch for scrolling and CSS, main landmark on the admin login.

title: No limit on password guesses
fix: Done: after 5 wrong passwords in 5 minutes, logins are refused (429) until the window passes.

title: Error responses carried a stack trace; the Server header named the Python version
fix: Done: 500 responses say where to look (the terminal) without the trace; sys_version is empty.

title: Default password admin99
fix: Not changed (requested by the owner for now). Set KASFLEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD before any session outside a supervised workshop; the start-up banner now says so.

title: Participants can still set their own study condition and switch the safety check off from devtools
fix: Not changed: the grower page sends both by design (version stamp, safety demonstration). If the study needs it tamper-proof, take condition from the workshop state on the server and record checker-off runs as demonstrations.

title: CSP allows inline styles
fix: Not changed: style attributes are set from script for charts. Scripts are already limited to 'self'; inline style is a low-value XSS vector here.

title: No .env.example
fix: Done: lists every variable, no values.

title: GL-Gym is AGPL-3.0-or-later
missing_fact: WUR's answer to the questions in docs/WUR_LICENCE_CHECK.md. Released binaries do not bundle gl-gym (verified in packaging/kasflex.spec); hosting the worker as a service would trigger AGPL section 13.

title: HTTPS and HSTS missing
reason: The server binds to 127.0.0.1 only and refuses other Host headers; TLS on loopback adds nothing. Becomes relevant only if the app is ever hosted, which the module docstring forbids.

title: innerHTML in the research workspace (app.js)
reason: All eight sinks build SVG or fixed markup from numbers and developer-owned strings; server text goes through escapeHtml or textContent (covered by test_advanced_ui_does_not_put_api_errors_or_reasoning_directly_into_html).

title: Static file path traversal
reason: _static resolves the path and refuses anything outside STATIC_DIR; .env returns 404 (test_local_endpoint_saves_and_refuses_cross_origin).

title: Secrets in the repository
reason: scan_secrets.py: the only hits are the git-ignored local .env and a pandas test fixture inside the untracked .venv-greenlight.
